NCBI / Spidey Public Domain Notice
==================================

Runtime binaries:
- PrimeRL/tools/bin/Spidey.exe
- PrimeRL/tools/bin/Spidey_AVX2_FMA3.exe

NCBI software notice text (primary-source excerpt):
- "The NCBI toolkit software and data are produced and distributed by NCBI,
  an agency of the United States Government. NCBl software is therefore a "United States
  Government Work" under the terms of the United States Copyright Act."
- "As a 'United States Government Work', the NCBI software is released into the public domain."
- "The NCBI software is provided on an 'as is' basis..."

Primary source:
- NCBI C++ Toolkit public-domain notice:
  https://ncbi.github.io/cxx-toolkit/pages/ch_public
- NCBI policies/disclaimer:
  https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/home/about/policies/#disclaimer

Release note:
- If a bundled Spidey binary contains additional third-party code or separate notices,
  include those notices in this folder as well.
